text:
### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, traces contained A14, A15, A30, A31, A47 and A48 in essentially every case, plus one of two alternative triplets: A33+A35+A36 ran together in about 49 in 100 traces and A37+A38+A39 in about 51 in 100, while pairs spanning the two triplets (e.g. A33 with A37) shared a trace in only about 1 in 100 cases. In the later window both triplets run together: cross-triplet pairs co-occur in about 98 in 100 traces, with the first triplet before the second in about 95–98 in 100. [REL037, REL039, REL041, REL044, REL045, REL047, REL050, REL052]
- The triplets also became near-mandatory: in the later window A33, A35 and A36 each appear in about 98–99 in 100 traces (about 49 before), and A37, A38 and A39 in about 99–100 in 100 (about 52 before). [POS005, POS006, POS007, POS008, POS009, POS010]
- A04 receded: it appeared in about 59 in 100 traces before and about 26 in 100 in the later window, with its remaining occurrences sitting later in the trace (mean relative position about 0.20 versus 0.38). Before, A04 co-occurred with A14, A15, A30, A31, A47 and A48 in about 59 in 100 traces and preceded them in about 53–55; in the later window those activities occur without A04 in about 74–75 in 100 traces. [POS001, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL011, REL012]
- Routing around A04 changed accordingly: A14's observed outgoing transitions went to A04 in about 57 in 100 cases before (about 43 to A15); in the later window about 79 in 100 go to A15 and about 12 to A04. A04's own outgoing transitions, about 90 in 100 to A15 before, now go to A15 in only about 40 in 100 and are otherwise spread over many successors. [DIR004, DIR002]
- Inside the merged block the gaps stretched: pairs such as A30→A37/A38/A39 and A33/A35/A36→A31 were typically 1–3 event positions apart before and are typically 4–5 apart in the later window. A30's immediate successors shifted from an even spread over A35–A39 to about 36, 31 and 29 in 100 on A35, A33 and A36, and A33/A35/A36 now also lead directly to A37/A38/A39 (about 9–13 in 100) while their direct transitions to A31 (about a third before) have nearly disappeared. [LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, LAG011, LAG013, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008]
- Secondary: A02 and A10 take part in more traces in the later window (observed outgoing transitions in about 40 and 50 traces versus about 12 and 11 before) with redistributed successor profiles. [DIR001, DIR003]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the exclusive choice between two activity groups was replaced by one combined, near-mandatory sequence: the triplets A33+A35+A36 and A37+A38+A39, previously alternatives (each in about half of all traces, together in about 1 in 100), now run together in about 98 in 100 traces — first triplet before second — alongside A14, A15, A30, A31, A47 and A48, which now co-occur with them in about 98–99 in 100 traces (about 49–53 before). At the same time A04, which previously preceded this block in most traces, is present in only about 26 in 100 traces, and A14 typically continues to A15 instead. The relation items show this change directly and consistently, the participation and direction items agree with it, every item's difference exceeds those of about 995 in 1000 random re-splits of the pooled data, and the screening context makes chance unlikely as a whole: 99 items qualified where roughly 1 would be expected without a change. Many items describe the same underlying restructuring, so they corroborate rather than independently confirm it. [REL039, REL013, REL025, REL031, POS005, POS001, DIR004, DIR002]

A competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out is that A04's decline and the merge of the two triplets are two coinciding changes rather than one restructuring. POS and LAG use event positions, so the later placement of A04 and the stretched gaps show sequence distance, not movement in clock time; a few lag items rest on very few observations in one window and were not relied on. [POS001, LAG009, LAG012]

Other differences: A02 and A10 participate in more traces with changed successor profiles in the later window. [DIR001, DIR003]
